simple.meaning: נָסַס (nâçaç) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to raise a beacon.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Zechariah, beginning at Zechariah 9:16. The surrounding contexts include flock.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָסַס (H5264) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: נָסַס (nâçaç) / H5264 is traced through Zechariah 9:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; to gleam from afar, i.e. to be conspicuous as a signal; or rather perhaps a denominative from 5251 (and identical with 5263 , through the idea of a flag as fluttering in the wind);
